messages:
Nadia: Heads up 1: vendor update: delayed manifest for reserved racks linked to RESV-90177. ETA slipped from May 3 -> May 18.
Evan: which site/reservation?
Nadia: This is for the EU-Dedicated region (racks GN12). Vendor cites port congestion + customs paperwork.
Ravi: thatll impact the partner onboarding timeline for ByteCloud pilot. We had planned cutover May 7.
Maya: Any option to split the shipment? Move some racks by truck from nearby EU port to our secondary DC?
Nadia: vendor said partial re-route inside EU is possible but requires an amendment to the PO and a customs broker fee.
Clara: we should trigger the marketplace fallback plan if we have available onsite reserved inventory or compatible marketplace SKUs. Check inventory pool for gn11-compat and gn10-quant.
LogiBot: manifest RESV-90177 status -> DELAYED_AT_ORIGIN, last_update 2026-05-01T09:12Z
Evan: suggestion: propose 30% temporary reroute to `gn11-compat` for 2 weeks, hold 70% for reserved allocation, and open expedited cross-dock for 1 rack if vendor can move it EU-internal.
Ravi: need signoff from partnerships and finance for cross-dock fees. Also inform the SI for schedule changes.
Maya: I'll draft the partner communication. Keep it factual: ETA change, mitigation options (reroute/cross-dock/air), expected cost delta.
Nadia: action list: (1) Maya to draft communication, (2) Clara to check onsite inventory and marketplace pool, (3) Evan to coordinate with vendor on partial EU reroute feasibility and cost, (4) Ravi to update ByteCloud pilot timeline.
Clara: inventory_check: gn11-compat -> 4 racks available in EU-WEST-2, gn10-quant -> 2 racks.
Evan: vendor response: partial EU trucking possible for 1-2 racks but customs broker + expedited handling = ~$4.2k per rack extra. Air not feasible for EU-internal leg.
Maya: draft sent to partners list for review. Copying SI lead @deepak_si and marketplace PM @oliver_mkt.
Ravi: updated ByteCloud pilot plan: move cutover to May 20-25 window; will keep stakeholders posted.
Nadia: keeping this thread open until vendor confirms final manifest. Updated the tracker: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/capacity-tracker (RESV-90177). :spiral_calendar:
